articles.summary: Kinetik Holdings Inc. (NYSE: KNTK) (“ Kinetik ” or the “ Company ”) today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Kinetik reported net income including noncontrolling interest of $15.5 million and $109.2 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively. Kinetik generated Adjusted EBITDA 1 of $242.6 million and $735.6 million, Distributable Cash Flow 1 of $158.5 million and $468.8 million, and Free Cash Flow 1 of $50.9 million and $179.2 mi
articles.title: Kinetik Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial and Operating Results and Revises 2025 Financial Guidance
